title: So‘z yasash: old va oxirgi qo‘shimchalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida old va oxirgi qo‘shimchalar yordamida bitta o‘zakdan kamida o‘nta to‘g‘ri so‘z yasaysiz, so‘z oilasidagi urg‘u ko‘chishini to‘g‘ri talaffuz qilasiz va imtihon uslubidagi so‘z yasash topshirig‘ining kamida sakkiz bandidan yettitasini to‘g‘ri bajarasiz.

vocab.uz: unumli, hozir ham yangi so‘z yasaydigan
konversiya, so‘zning qo‘shimchasiz boshqa turkumga o‘tishi

scenes.title: So‘z yasash darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda madaniy kontekst va tarixiy ishoralarni o‘rgandik. Bugun so‘zning ichiga kiramiz: old va oxirgi qo‘shimchalar, so‘z oilalari, yangi so‘zni to‘g‘ri yasash va imtihondagi so‘z yasash topshirig‘i. Dars oxirida bitta o‘zakdan kamida o‘nta to‘g‘ri so‘z yasay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we explored cultural allusions. Today we go inside the word itself, and learn to build a whole family of words from a single root.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz. Oldingi safar madaniy ishoralarni o‘rgandik. Bugun so‘zning ichiga kiramiz va bitta o‘zakdan butun bir so‘z oilasini yasashni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: So‘zning tuzilishi

examples.t: The weather here is completely unpredictable.
examples.uz: Bu yerda ob-havoni umuman oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Avval asosiy mantiq. Murakkab inglizcha so‘z ko‘pincha uch qismdan iborat: old qo‘shimcha, o‘zak va oxirgi qo‘shimcha. Unpredictable: un, predict, able. Eslab qoling: old qo‘shimcha odatda ma’noni o‘zgartiradi, oxirgi qo‘shimcha esa ko‘pincha so‘z turkumini: fe’ldan ot, otdan sifat yasaydi.
scenes.say: Take unpredictable: un, predict, able. As a rule of thumb, prefixes change the meaning, while suffixes change the word class.
scenes.say_uz: Unpredictable: un, predict, able. Odatda old qo‘shimcha ma’noni, oxirgi qo‘shimcha esa so‘z turkumini o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek tili bilan farq

examples.t: It's impossible.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tili agglutinativ: so‘zni deyarli faqat oxirgi qo‘shimchalar bilan yasaymiz: ish, ishchi, ishchan, ishsiz. Old qo‘shimchalar bizda kam va asosan fors tilidan kirgan: bevafo, noma’lum. Ingliz tilida esa ular juda faol. Shuning uchun biz ko‘pincha ‘not possible’ deymiz, ingliz esa bitta so‘z bilan ‘impossible’ deydi.
scenes.say: Uzbek builds words almost entirely with suffixes. English uses suffixes too, but it also relies heavily on prefixes, especially for negation.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tili so‘zlarni deyarli faqat oxirgi qo‘shimchalar bilan yasaydi. Ingliz tili ham ulardan foydalanadi, lekin, ayniqsa inkor uchun, old qo‘shimchalarga ham ko‘p tayanadi.

scenes.title: Inkor old qo‘shimchalari
board: il- + l: illegal · ir- + r: irregular

examples.t: The figures in the report were inaccurate.
Leaving the children alone was irresponsible.

scenes.say_native: Inkor old qo‘shimchalari. Eng keng tarqalgani un: unclear, unlikely. In ko‘pincha lotincha o‘zaklar bilan keladi va tovushga moslashadi: p, b, m dan oldin im: impossible, immature; l dan oldin il: illegal; r dan oldin ir: irregular. Bu talaffuzni osonlashtiradi. Dis esa harakat yoki sifatni teskari qiladi: disagree, dishonest.
scenes.say: Un- is the commonest negative prefix. In- changes shape to suit the next sound: impossible, illegal, irregular. Dis- reverses: disagree, dishonest.
scenes.say_uz: Un — eng keng tarqalgan inkor old qo‘shimchasi. In keyingi tovushga moslashadi: impossible, illegal, irregular. Dis teskari qiladi: disagree, dishonest.

scenes.title: Ma’no beruvchi old qo‘shimchalar

examples.t: The young company outperformed its rivals.
examples.uz: Yosh kompaniya raqiblaridan yaxshiroq natija ko‘rsatdi.

scenes.say_native: Ma’no beruvchi old qo‘shimchalar. Mis noto‘g‘ri: misjudge. Over va under ortiqcha va kam: overestimate, underestimate. Re qayta: reconsider. Counter qarshi: counterproductive, ya’ni teskari natija beradigan. Out esa ‘dan ko‘proq’: outnumber, outperform. O‘zbekchada bular uchun butun ibora kerak, inglizchada bitta old qo‘shimcha yetadi.
scenes.say: Mis- means wrongly, over- and under- mean too much and too little, counter- means against. And out- means more than: the young company outperformed its rivals.
scenes.say_uz: Mis — noto‘g‘ri, over va under — ortiqcha va kam, counter — qarshi. Out — dan ko‘proq: yosh kompaniya raqiblaridan o‘zib ketdi.

scenes.title: Ot yasovchi qo‘shimchalar

examples.t: Public awareness of the issue has grown.
examples.uz: Jamoatchilikning bu masala haqidagi xabardorligi oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Ot yasovchilar. Fe’ldan ot: decision, agreement, reliance. Sifatdan ot: awareness, complexity. Ship, hood, dom holat yoki maqomni bildiradi: leadership, childhood, freedom. E’tibor bering: er yoki or bajaruvchini, ee esa harakat yo‘naltirilgan odamni bildiradi. Employer ish beruvchi, employee xodim. Trainer o‘rgatadi, trainee o‘rganadi.
scenes.say: Verbs become nouns with -tion, -ment or -ance; adjectives with -ness or -ity. And the employer does the hiring, while the employee is hired.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llar tion, ment yoki ance bilan, sifatlar ness yoki ity bilan otga aylanadi. Employer ishga oladi, employee ishga olinadi.

scenes.title: Sifat yasovchi qo‘shimchalar

examples.t: Let's meet at sevenish.

scenes.say_native: Sifat yasovchilar. Able va ible imkoniyat: reliable, ya’ni ishonsa bo‘ladigan. Ful va less: meaningful, meaningless. O‘zbekchadagi ‘siz’ less ga juda o‘xshaydi: ma’nosiz, uysiz, homeless. Lekin har bir ful so‘zining less jufti bo‘lavermaydi. Ish esa ‘taxminan’ degani: reddish, ya’ni qizg‘ish, sevenish, ya’ni soat yettilar atrofida.
scenes.say: A meaningful discussion has substance; a meaningless one has none. And -ish approximates: a reddish sky. Let's meet at sevenish.
scenes.say_uz: Meaningful muhokamaning mazmuni bor, meaningless muhokamaning yo‘q. Ish taxminiylikni bildiradi: qizg‘ish osmon. Soat yettilar atrofida uchrashaylik.

scenes.title: Fe’l va ravish yasovchilar

examples.t: We need to simplify the process.

scenes.say_native: Fe’l yasovchilar: ise, ify, en. Modernise, simplify, widen. Old qo‘shimcha en ham fe’l yasaydi: enable, empower. Bu kam uchraydigan holat, chunki bu yerda old qo‘shimcha turkumni o‘zgartirgan. Britaniyada ise ham, ize ham to‘g‘ri, faqat izchil bo‘ling; Amerikada ize. Lekin analyse Britaniyada faqat yse bilan. Og‘zaki nutqda wise ham faol: money-wise.
scenes.say: Modernise, simplify, widen, enable. In British English both -ise and -ize are fine if you are consistent. And informally: money-wise, the plan works.
scenes.say_uz: Modernise, simplify, widen, enable. Britaniyada izchil bo‘lsangiz ise ham, ize ham to‘g‘ri. Og‘zaki: pul jihatidan reja ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Hamma joyda un- emas
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: hamma joyda un ishlatish. Unpossible, unlegal, unresponsible degan so‘zlar yo‘q: impossible, illegal, irresponsible. Inhonest emas, dishonest. Lekin bu yuz foizlik qoida emas: unlimited, unreal, unpopular ham bor. Shubha bo‘lsa, lug‘atga qarang.
scenes.say: Impossible, illegal, irresponsible, dishonest. But unlimited and unpopular show it's a tendency, not a law.
scenes.say_uz: Impossible, illegal, irresponsible, dishonest. Lekin unlimited va unpopular bu qonun emas, tendensiya ekanini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Inkor shaklini yasang
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizda. Oltita so‘z, har biriga to‘g‘ri inkor old qo‘shimchasini qo‘ying va yangi so‘zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi harfga qarang, u sizga ishora beradi. To‘rtinchi so‘z fe’l, shuning uchun u yerda boshqa old qo‘shimcha kerak bo‘ladi. Javobni butun so‘z bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Make each word negative. Legible. Mature. Relevant. Obey. Patient. Comfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir so‘zni inkor shaklga keltiring: legible, mature, relevant, obey, patient, comfortable.

scenes.title: Javoblar

examples.t: His handwriting is almost illegible.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Legible l bilan boshlangani uchun illegible, ya’ni o‘qib bo‘lmaydigan. Mature dan immature, relevant dan irrelevant. Obey fe’l, uning inkori disobey. Patient dan impatient. Comfortable bilan esa un ishlatiladi: uncomfortable. Beshtasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib.
scenes.say: Illegible, immature, irrelevant. Disobey, because obey is a verb. Impatient and uncomfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Illegible, immature, irrelevant. Disobey, chunki obey fe’l. Impatient va uncomfortable.

scenes.title: un-, dis-, non-: ma’no farqi

examples.t: We need a disinterested expert to settle the dispute.
examples.uz: Nizoni hal qilish uchun xolis mutaxassis kerak.

scenes.say_native: Nozik farq: turli inkor qo‘shimchalar turli ma’no beradi. Unprofessional bu tanqid: kasbga yarashmaydigan xulq. Non-professional esa shunchaki havaskor, unda baho yo‘q. Uninterested qiziqmaydigan, disinterested esa an’anaviy ma’noda xolis, beg‘araz. Rasmiy matnda disinterested ni xolis ma’nosida ishlatgan ma’qul.
scenes.say: Unprofessional criticises behaviour; non-professional simply means amateur. And a disinterested judge is impartial, not bored.
scenes.say_uz: Unprofessional xulqni tanqid qiladi, non-professional esa shunchaki havaskor. Disinterested hakam zerikkan emas, xolis.

scenes.title: Bir o‘zak, ikki sifat

examples.t: It was a historic victory.
She writes historical novels.

scenes.say_native: Bir o‘zakdan ma’nosi farqli ikki sifat chiqishi mumkin. Economic iqtisodiyotga oid, economical tejamkor. Historic tarixiy ahamiyatga ega: a historic victory; historical tarixga tegishli: historical documents. Sensible oqilona, sensitive sezgir; ko‘pchilik sensible ni ‘sezgir’ deb xato qiladi. Childish salbiy, childlike ijobiy.
scenes.say: Economic growth, but an economical car. A historic victory, but a historical novel. Sensible means reasonable; sensitive means easily affected.
scenes.say_uz: Iqtisodiy o‘sish, lekin tejamkor mashina. Tarixiy ahamiyatli g‘alaba, lekin tarixiy roman. Sensible — oqilona, sensitive — sezgir.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri sifatni tanlang
board: 1) a ___ decision to sign the treaty (historic/historical)
scenes.say_native: Endi tanlang. To‘rtta gap, har birida ikki sifatdan biri kerak. Ma’noni o‘ylab ko‘ring: bu yerda baho bormi yoki shunchaki tavsifmi, ijobiymi yoki salbiymi? Javobingizni butun gap bilan ayting. Har bir juftda bitta so‘z baho beradi, ikkinchisi esa faqat tavsiflaydi. Shu farqni sezsangiz, to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz.
scenes.say: Choose. One: a blank decision to sign the treaty. Two: a small, blank car. Three: a blank issue for many families. Four: his blank sense of wonder.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlang. Bir: shartnomani imzolash … qaror. Ikki: kichik, … mashina. Uch: ko‘p oilalar uchun … masala. To‘rt: uning … hayratlanish tuyg‘usi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Historic, chunki shartnoma imzolash tarixda muhim voqea. Economical, ya’ni kam yoqilg‘i sarflaydigan mashina. Sensitive, ya’ni nozik, ehtiyotkorlik talab qiladigan mavzu. Childlike, chunki hayratlanish bu yerda maqtov. Agar childish desangiz, uni tanqid qilgan bo‘lasiz.
scenes.say: Historic, economical, sensitive and childlike, because the sense of wonder is praised, not criticised.
scenes.say_uz: Historic, economical, sensitive va childlike, chunki hayratlanish tanqid emas, maqtalmoqda.

scenes.title: So‘z oilasi nima

examples.t: The committee is still undecided.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: so‘z oilalari. Bitta o‘zakdan yasalgan barcha so‘zlar bir oila. Decide dan decision, decisive, decisively; inkor bilan indecisive, indecision, undecided. Oilani o‘rgansangiz, bitta so‘z o‘rniga yettitasini egallaysiz. O‘zbekchada ham bilim, bilimdon, bilimsiz kabi oilalar bor.
scenes.say: From decide we get decision, decisive, decisively, indecisive, indecision and undecided. Learn the family, not the single word.
scenes.say_uz: Decide dan decision, decisive, decisively, indecisive, indecision va undecided. Alohida so‘zni emas, oilani o‘rganing.

scenes.title: Oila ichida ma’no ajralishi

examples.t: The team won three successive matches.
examples.uz: Jamoa ketma-ket uchta o‘yinda g‘alaba qozondi.

scenes.say_native: Oila ichida ma’no ajralishi mumkin. Succeed ham muvaffaqiyat qozonmoq, ham kimningdir o‘rnini egallamoq. Birinchisidan success, successful; ikkinchisidan succession, ya’ni vorislik, successive, ya’ni ketma-ket, successor, ya’ni voris. Three successive wins uchta ketma-ket g‘alaba degani.
scenes.say: Succeed means both to achieve and to follow someone. So three successive wins means three wins in a row.
scenes.say_uz: Succeed — ham erishmoq, ham kimningdir ortidan kelmoq. Shuning uchun three successive wins — ketma-ket uchta g‘alaba.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u ko‘chishi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz nuqtasi: so‘z oilasida urg‘u ko‘chadi. PHOtograph, phoTOgrapher, photoGRAPHic. Economy da urg‘u ikkinchi, economic da uchinchi bo‘g‘inda. Tion, ic, ity urg‘uni o‘zidan oldingi bo‘g‘inga tortadi. O‘zbekchada urg‘u odatda oxirgi bo‘g‘inda, shuning uchun buni alohida mashq qiling. Urg‘usiz unlilar shvaga aylanadi.
scenes.say: Photograph, photographer, photographic. Economy, economic. Suffixes like -ic and -ity pull the stress to the syllable before them.
scenes.say_uz: Photograph, photographer, photographic. Economy, economic. Ic va ity kabi qo‘shimchalar urg‘uni o‘zidan oldingi bo‘g‘inga tortadi.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni toping
scenes.say_native: Uchta oila, har birida uchta so‘z. Har bir so‘zni ovoz chiqarib ayting va asosiy urg‘u qaysi bo‘g‘inga tushishini aniqlang. Qoidani eslang: ical, ian va ity urg‘uni o‘zidan oldingi bo‘g‘inga tortadi. Shoshilmang, har birini ikki marta ayting. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni biroz uzunroq va balandroq ayting.
scenes.say: Where is the stress? Politics, political, politician. Analyse, analysis, analytical. Product, productive, productivity.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘u qayerda? Politics, political, politician. Analyse, analysis, analytical. Product, productive, productivity.

scenes.title: Urg‘u javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. POLitics, poLITical, poliTIcian: urg‘u har safar bir bo‘g‘in o‘ngga siljiydi. ANalyse, aNALysis, anaLYTical. PROduct, proDUCtive, producTIVity. Urg‘u ko‘chganda, oldingi urg‘uli unli zaiflashadi: political ning birinchi bo‘g‘ini qisqa ‘pa’ bo‘lib eshitiladi.
scenes.say: In each family the stress moves right as suffixes are added, and the vowel it leaves behind becomes weak.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir oilada qo‘shimchalar qo‘shilgan sari urg‘u o‘ngga siljiydi, u tashlab ketgan unli zaiflashadi.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri so‘z turkumi
scenes.say_native: Eng tipik xato: kerakli so‘z turkumini tanlamaslik. He is very success emas, successful. An importance decision emas, important. A danger situation emas, dangerous. She argued convincing emas, convincingly. O‘zbekchada ham ‘xavf vaziyat’ emas, ‘xavfli vaziyat’ deymiz, mantiq bir xil.
scenes.say: He is very successful. An important decision. A dangerous situation. She argued convincingly.
scenes.say_uz: U juda muvaffaqiyatli. Muhim qaror. Xavfli vaziyat. U ishonarli bahslashdi.

scenes.title: Tirik va qotgan qo‘shimchalar

examples.t: I've rewatched that series twice.
examples.uz: O‘sha serialni ikki marta qayta ko‘rdim.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: yangi so‘zni to‘g‘ri yasash. Ba’zi qo‘shimchalar hozir ham tirik: un, re, ness, able, ise, ish, free, friendly. Masalan, unfollow, rewatch, sugar-free, eco-friendly. Boshqalari qotib qolgan: th qo‘shimchasi warmth, depth da bor, lekin u bilan yangi so‘z yasalmaydi.
scenes.say: Productive affixes keep creating words: unfollow, rewatch, sugar-free. But nobody coins new words with -th today.
scenes.say_uz: Unumli qo‘shimchalar yangi so‘zlar yaratishda davom etadi: unfollow, rewatch, sugar-free. Lekin bugun th bilan hech kim yangi so‘z yasamaydi.

scenes.title: Cheklovlar: blocking

examples.t: Is this jacket washable?

scenes.say_native: Cheklovlar ham bor. Agar tilda tayyor so‘z bo‘lsa, yangi yasama odatda ishlatilmaydi; tilshunoslar buni blocking deydi. Stealer emas, thief. Arrivement emas, arrival. Able esa asosan o‘timli fe’llarga qo‘shiladi: washable, readable. Shuning uchun avval tayyor so‘z yo‘qligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: An existing word blocks a new one: thief, not stealer; arrival, not arrivement. And -able likes transitive verbs: a washable jacket.
scenes.say_uz: Mavjud so‘z yangisini to‘sadi: stealer emas, thief; arrivement emas, arrival. Able o‘timli fe’llarni yoqtiradi: yuvsa bo‘ladigan kurtka.

scenes.title: Qo‘shimchasiz yasash: konversiya
board: noun → verb: to google, to email
verb → noun: a must, a given, a big ask

examples.t: Patience is a must in this job.

scenes.say_native: Qo‘shimchasiz yasash ham bor, uni konversiya deyishadi. So‘z shaklini o‘zgartirmay boshqa turkumga o‘tadi: ot fe’lga, to google, to email; fe’l otga, a must, a given. That’s a big ask, ya’ni bu katta iltimos. O‘zbek tilida biz deyarli har doim qo‘shimcha qo‘shamiz, shuning uchun bu usul bizga notanish.
scenes.say: Conversion needs no affix at all. Just google it. Patience is a must. That's a big ask.
scenes.say_uz: Konversiyaga qo‘shimcha kerak emas. Shunchaki googlelang. Sabr shart. Bu katta iltimos.

scenes.title: Qo‘shimcha va imlo
scenes.say_native: Qo‘shimcha qo‘shilganda imlo o‘zgarishi mumkin. Argue dan argument, true dan truly: e tushadi. Happy dan happiness: y i ga aylanadi. Lekin notice dan noticeable: e saqlanadi, aks holda c ‘k’ deb o‘qilardi. Britaniyada judgement, Amerikada va huquqiy matnlarda judgment. Imtihonda bunday xatolar ball olib ketadi.
scenes.say: Argument, truly, happiness. But noticeable keeps its e so the c stays soft. And judgement is British, judgment American.
scenes.say_uz: Argument, truly, happiness. Lekin noticeable da c yumshoq qolishi uchun e saqlanadi. Judgement — Britaniya, judgment — Amerika shakli.

scenes.title: Tinglash: hisobotni tahrirlash
board: Listen for: one word instead of a phrase
scenes.say_native: Endi suhbat tinglaymiz. Ikki hamkasb, Anna va Ben, hisobotni tahrir qilishyapti. Ular uzun, noaniq iboralarni bitta aniq yasama so‘z bilan almashtirishyapti. Qaysi so‘z qaysi ibora o‘rnini egallaganini kuzating, keyin savollar beraman. Bunday tahrir rasmiy yozuvda juda qadrlanadi.
scenes.say: Anna: This sentence says we didn't think so many people would come. Can we tighten it? Ben: How about, we underestimated attendance? Anna: Better. And here, the old system was not efficient. Ben: The old system was inefficient. Or even counterproductive. Anna: Counterproductive is much stronger. Was it really that bad? Ben: Honestly, yes. It created more paperwork than it removed. Anna: Then keep it.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Bu gapda ‘shuncha ko‘p odam keladi deb o‘ylamagan edik’ deyilgan. Qisqartirsak bo‘ladimi? Ben: ‘Ishtirokchilar sonini past baholadik’ desak-chi? Anna: Yaxshiroq. Mana bu yerda ‘eski tizim samarali emas edi’. Ben: Eski tizim samarasiz edi. Hatto teskari natija beradigan edi. Anna: Bu ancha kuchli. Haqiqatan shunchalik yomonmidi? Ben: Rostini aytsam, ha. U qog‘ozbozlikni kamaytirish o‘rniga ko‘paytirdi. Anna: Unda qoldiramiz.

scenes.title: Suhbatni tushundingizmi?
board: 1) What replaced 'we didn't think so many would come'?
2) Which two words describe the old system?
3) Why does Ben keep the stronger word?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: ‘shuncha ko‘p odam keladi deb o‘ylamagan edik’ iborasi nima bilan almashtirildi? Ikkinchi: eski tizim uchun qaysi ikki so‘z taklif qilindi? Uchinchi: Ben nega kuchliroq so‘zni qoldirdi? Javoblarni inglizcha ayting. Javob uchun qisqa ibora yetarli.
scenes.say: One: what replaced the idea that they didn't expect so many people? Two: which two words describe the old system? Three: why keep the stronger one?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ‘shuncha odamni kutmagan edik’ fikri nima bilan almashtirildi? Ikki: eski tizimni qaysi ikki so‘z tasvirlaydi? Uch: nega kuchlirog‘i qoldirildi?

scenes.title: Suhbat javoblari
board: 3) It created more paperwork than it removed.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: we underestimated attendance. Ikkinchi: inefficient va counterproductive. Inefficient samarasiz, counterproductive esa kuchliroq: kutilganining teskarisini beradigan. Uchinchi: tizim qog‘ozbozlikni kamaytirish o‘rniga ko‘paytirgan. Har safar bitta yasama so‘z butun jumlaning ishini bajardi.
scenes.say: We underestimated attendance. Inefficient and counterproductive. Because it created more paperwork than it removed.
scenes.say_uz: Ishtirokchilar sonini past baholadik. Inefficient va counterproductive. Chunki u qog‘ozbozlikni kamaytirish o‘rniga ko‘paytirdi.

scenes.title: Ta’rifdan so‘z yasang
board: 4) to estimate too low · 5) impossible to describe
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz so‘z yasang. Beshta ta’rif, har biriga bitta so‘z. Avval qaysi so‘z turkumi kerakligini aniqlang: ot, fe’l yoki sifat. Keyin o‘zakni toping va kerakli old yoki oxirgi qo‘shimchani qo‘shing. Beshinchisida ikkala qo‘shimcha ham kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: One word for each. The state of being aware. To make modern. A person who is interviewed. To estimate too low. Impossible to describe.
scenes.say_uz: Har biriga bitta so‘z. Xabardorlik holati. Zamonaviy qilmoq. Intervyu olinadigan shaxs. Past baholamoq. Tasvirlab bo‘lmaydigan.

scenes.title: Javoblar

examples.t: The view from the summit was indescribable.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Awareness, ness bilan holat oti. Modernise, Britaniyada ize bilan ham mumkin. Interviewee, chunki ee harakat yo‘naltirilgan shaxs. Underestimate. Va indescribable: in, describe, able, oxirgi e tushadi. Bu so‘zda old va oxirgi qo‘shimcha birga ishladi; imtihonda bunday so‘zlar ko‘p.
scenes.say: Awareness, modernise, interviewee, underestimate and indescribable.
scenes.say_uz: Awareness, modernise, interviewee, underestimate va indescribable.

scenes.title: Imtihondagi so‘z yasash topshirig‘i
board: Reading and Use of English, Part 3
Change the word to fit the gap
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: imtihon. Cambridge C2 Proficiency imtihonining Reading and Use of English qismida, uchinchi bo‘limda, sakkizta bo‘sh joyli matn bo‘ladi. Har biri uchun katta harflarda o‘zak so‘z beriladi, siz uni mos shaklga keltirasiz. C1 Advanced da ham shunday topshiriq bor. Imlo xatosi bo‘lsa, javob qabul qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: In C2 Proficiency, Use of English Part 3 gives you eight gaps and a root word in capitals for each. Grammar, meaning and spelling must all be right.
scenes.say_uz: C2 Proficiency da Use of English ning uchinchi qismida sakkizta bo‘sh joy va har biriga katta harfli o‘zak beriladi. Grammatika, ma’no va imlo — hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: To‘rt qadamli strategiya
board: 1) Read the whole text for gist
scenes.say_native: To‘rt qadam. Birinchi, matnni oxirigacha tez o‘qib, umumiy ma’noni tushuning. Ikkinchi, bo‘sh joy atrofidagi grammatikadan so‘z turkumini aniqlang: artikldan keyin ot, otdan oldin sifat. Uchinchi, inkor, ko‘plik yoki zamon kerakmi, tekshiring; ko‘p ball shu yerda yo‘qoladi. To‘rtinchi, imloni harfma-harf tekshiring.
scenes.say: Read for gist. Identify the word class. Check for negatives, plurals and tense. Then check your spelling letter by letter.
scenes.say_uz: Umumiy ma’noni o‘qing. So‘z turkumini aniqlang. Inkor, ko‘plik va zamonni tekshiring. Keyin imloni harfma-harf tekshiring.

scenes.title: C2 darajasidagi o‘zgarishlar

examples.t: Her talent is simply incomparable.

scenes.say_native: C2 darajasida ko‘pincha o‘zakning o‘zi o‘zgaradi. Deep dan depth, strong dan strength va strengthen, choose dan choice, prove dan proof. Ko‘pincha ikki o‘zgarish birdaniga kerak: compare dan incomparable, willing dan unwillingness. Har bir bo‘sh joyda so‘rang: bitta o‘zgarish yetarlimi yoki ikkitasi kerakmi?
scenes.say: Deep gives depth, strong gives strengthen, prove gives proof. And some need two changes: incomparable, unwillingness.
scenes.say_uz: Deep dan depth, strong dan strengthen, prove dan proof. Ba’zilariga ikki o‘zgarish kerak: incomparable, unwillingness.

scenes.title: Imtihon tuzoqlari
scenes.say_native: Uchta tuzoq. Birinchi, ko‘plikni unutish: several dan keyin disagreements. Ikkinchi, inkorni o‘tkazib yuborish: natija kutilmagan bo‘lsa, unpredictable. Uchinchi, imlo: strength so‘zida g dan keyin t va h keladi. So‘zni to‘g‘ri tanlasangiz ham, bitta harf xatosi ballni olib ketadi.
scenes.say: Remember the plural, spot the negative, and spell strength correctly. One wrong letter loses the mark.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘plikni unutmang, inkorni sezing va strength ni to‘g‘ri yozing. Bitta noto‘g‘ri harf ballni yo‘qotadi.

scenes.title: Imtihon uslubidagi matn
board: (1) Despite the ___ of calm, the talks were tense. (APPEAR)
(2) Neither side moved: a striking ___ to compromise. (WILLING)
(4) Nobody saw it coming: it was entirely ___. (PREDICT)
scenes.say_native: Imtihon uslubidagi qisqa matn. To‘rtta bo‘sh joy, har biriga o‘zak so‘z berilgan. To‘rt qadamli strategiyani qo‘llang. Diqqat: matn muzokaralar qiyin o‘tgani haqida, demak ba’zi so‘zlarga inkor kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. Javoblarni yozib qo‘ying. Javobni yozgach, harflarni bittalab sanab chiqing.
scenes.say: Fill the gaps. Despite the blank of calm, from appear. A striking blank to compromise, from willing. Several blank, from agree. Entirely blank, from predict.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh joylarni to‘ldiring. Xotirjamlik …ga qaramay (appear). Murosaga keskin … (willing). Bir nechta … (agree). Butunlay … (predict).

scenes.title: Matn javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Appearance, chunki ‘the’ dan keyin ot kerak. Unwillingness: inkor va ness, chunki hech bir tomon yon bermadi. Disagreements, several ko‘plikni talab qiladi. Unpredictable, chunki natijani hech kim kutmagan. To‘rttasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz bu topshiriqqa tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: Appearance, unwillingness, disagreements and unpredictable.
scenes.say_uz: Appearance, unwillingness, disagreements va unpredictable.

scenes.title: O‘zak ichidagi o‘zgarishlar
scenes.say_native: Yana bir mashq, bu safar o‘zak ichidagi o‘zgarishlar va kamroq ko‘rinadigan qo‘shimchalar bilan. To‘rtta ibora. Har birida avval so‘z turkumini aniqlang. Ikkinchi iborada ‘to’ dan keyin qanday so‘z kelishini eslang. Har bir o‘zakda ichki o‘zgarish bo‘lishi mumkinligini unutmang.
scenes.say: A blank of qualified staff, from short. To blank the economy, from strong. The blank of her knowledge, from deep. His sudden blank, from resign.
scenes.say_uz: Malakali xodimlar … (short). Iqtisodiyotni … (strong). Uning bilimi … (deep). Uning to‘satdan … (resign).

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Shortage, ya’ni tanqislik; shortness esa qisqalik, xodimlar yetishmovchiligi emas. Strengthen: ‘to’ dan keyin fe’l, o‘zak ham o‘zgaradi. Depth, ya’ni chuqurlik. Resignation, ya’ni iste’fo. Resign da g o‘qilmaydi, resignation da esa eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Shortage, strengthen, depth and resignation. The g is silent in resign but pronounced in resignation.
scenes.say_uz: Shortage, strengthen, depth va resignation. Resign da g o‘qilmaydi, resignation da o‘qiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: yangi so‘zlar qayerdan keladi
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Radio boshlovchisi lug‘atshunos bilan suhbatlashyapti: yangi so‘z lug‘atga qanday kiradi? Ayniqsa yangi so‘zlarning qanday yasalishi haqidagi qismni diqqat bilan tinglang, unda bugungi darsning asosiy g‘oyasi bor. Lug‘atshunos qisqa, lekin juda aniq javoblar beradi.
scenes.say: Presenter: So how does a new word earn its place in a dictionary? Lexicographer: Usage, above all. We check whether a word is used widely and over time, not just once. Presenter: And are most new words completely new? Lexicographer: Very few are. Most are built from existing parts: a familiar prefix, a familiar suffix, or two words joined together. Unfriend is a good example. Presenter: So the old machinery keeps working. Lexicographer: Exactly. It's recycling, not invention.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Yangi so‘z lug‘atdan qanday joy oladi? Lug‘atshunos: Avvalo, qo‘llanish orqali. So‘z bir marta emas, keng va uzoq vaqt davomida ishlatilyaptimi, shuni tekshiramiz. Boshlovchi: Yangi so‘zlarning ko‘pi butunlay yangimi? Lug‘atshunos: Juda oz qismi. Ko‘pchiligi mavjud qismlardan yasaladi: tanish old qo‘shimcha, tanish oxirgi qo‘shimcha yoki ikki so‘zning birikishi. Unfriend yaxshi misol. Boshlovchi: Demak, eski mexanizm ishlashda davom etyapti. Lug‘atshunos: Aynan. Bu ixtiro emas, qayta ishlash.

scenes.title: Intervyuni tushundingizmi?
board: 1) What matters most for a new word?
2) How are most new words made?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Lug‘atshunos fikricha, yangi so‘z uchun eng muhim narsa nima? Ko‘pchilik yangi so‘zlar qanday yasaladi? Qaysi misol keltirildi? Suhbat qaysi o‘xshatish bilan tugadi? Qisqa inglizcha javob bering. Javoblar uchun qisqa iboralar yetarli, to‘liq gap shart emas.
scenes.say: What matters most for a new word? How are most new words made? Which example is given? What comparison ends the interview?
scenes.say_uz: Yangi so‘z uchun eng muhimi nima? Ko‘pchilik yangi so‘zlar qanday yasaladi? Qaysi misol berildi? Intervyu qaysi o‘xshatish bilan tugadi?

scenes.title: Intervyu javoblari
board: 2) from existing parts: prefixes, suffixes, compounds
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: keng va uzoq vaqt ishlatilishi. Ikkinchi: mavjud qismlardan, ya’ni tanish qo‘shimchalar yoki ikki so‘zni qo‘shish orqali. Uchinchi: unfriend, bu yerda un harakatni bekor qiladi. To‘rtinchi: recycling, not invention, ya’ni ixtiro emas, qayta ishlash.
scenes.say: Wide usage over time. Existing parts. Unfriend. And recycling, not invention.
scenes.say_uz: Uzoq vaqt keng qo‘llanish. Mavjud qismlar. Unfriend. Va ixtiro emas, qayta ishlash.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bitta o‘zak
board: prefixes: re-, inter-, over-, counter-, in-, de-
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy ijodiy topshiriq. Bir daqiqa ichida act o‘zagidan imkon qadar ko‘p so‘z yasang va ulardan bir nechtasi bilan qisqa gap tuzing. Turkumlarni aralashtiring: ot, sifat, fe’l, ravish. Doskadagi old qo‘shimchalar sizga yordam beradi. Maqsad: kamida o‘nta to‘g‘ri so‘z.
scenes.say: In sixty seconds, build as many words as you can from act. Aim for at least ten.
scenes.say_uz: Oltmish soniyada act dan imkon qadar ko‘p so‘z yasang. Kamida o‘ntasini maqsad qiling.

scenes.title: Namuna javob

examples.t: Try not to overreact.
examples.uz: Haddan tashqari keskin javob qaytarmaslikka harakat qiling.

examples.t: The measures are meant to counteract inflation.
examples.uz: Choralar inflyatsiyaga qarshi kurashish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

scenes.say_native: Namuna. Otlar: action, activity, activist, actor. Sifat va ravish: active, actively, inactive. Fe’llar: activate, deactivate, react, interact, counteract, overreact. Ulardan yana reaction, interaction, interactive. O‘ntadan oshgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Muhimi, har bir so‘zning turkumini bilish.
scenes.say: Action, activity, activist, active, inactive, activate, react, interact, counteract, overreact. Try not to overreact.
scenes.say_uz: Action, activity, activist, active, inactive, activate, react, interact, counteract, overreact. Haddan oshib javob qaytarmang.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Old qo‘shimcha ma’noni, oxirgi qo‘shimcha turkumni o‘zgartiradi; im, il, ir tovushga moslashadi. So‘zni oila bo‘lib o‘rganing va urg‘u ko‘chishiga e’tibor bering. Yangi so‘zni tirik qo‘shimchalar bilan yasang va imloni tekshiring. Imtihonda turkum, inkor, ko‘plik va imloni tekshiring.
scenes.say: Prefixes change meaning, suffixes change class. Learn families, watch the stress, and check class, negative, plural and spelling.
scenes.say_uz: Old qo‘shimchalar ma’noni, oxirgilari turkumni o‘zgartiradi. Oilalarni o‘rganing, urg‘uga e’tibor bering, turkum, inkor, ko‘plik va imloni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: oltita o‘zak tanlang, masalan, decide, compare, strong, rely, predict va employ. Har biridan beshta so‘z yasang, jami o‘ttizta, har birining turkumini yozing va o‘ntasi bilan gap tuzing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hammasi lug‘atda bor, imlosi va turkumi to‘g‘ri. Keyingi darsda nozik grammatik nuanslar va istisnolarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Build thirty words from six roots and use ten in sentences. Next time: subtle grammar nuances and exceptions.
scenes.say_uz: Oltita o‘zakdan o‘ttizta so‘z yasang va o‘ntasini gaplarda ishlating. Keyingi safar: nozik grammatik nuanslar va istisnolar.

homework_uz: Oltita o‘zak tanlang (masalan, decide, compare, strong, rely, predict, employ) va har biridan beshtadan, jami o‘ttizta so‘z yasang. Har bir so‘z yonida uning turkumini (ot, fe’l, sifat, ravish) yozing va kamida o‘ntasi bilan o‘z gapingizni tuzing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘ttizta so‘zning hammasi lug‘atda mavjud, imlosi to‘g‘ri va turkumi to‘g‘ri belgilangan.

quiz.q: Which is the correct negative form of 'legal'?
quiz.why_uz: L dan oldin in- qo‘shimchasi il- ga aylanadi: illegal.

quiz.q: Which word means 'a person who is being trained'?
quiz.why_uz: -ee harakat yo‘naltirilgan shaxsni bildiradi; trainer esa o‘rgatuvchi.

quiz.q: We need a more ___ car; petrol is so expensive.
quiz.why_uz: Economical — tejamkor; economic esa iqtisodiyotga oid degani.

quiz.q: Where is the main stress in 'photographer'?
quiz.why_uz: Photographer da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda; o‘zbekcha odat bo‘yicha oxirgi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u berish xato.

quiz.q: 'The team won three successive matches' means the team won…
quiz.why_uz: Successive — ketma-ket; u succeed ning ‘o‘rnini egallamoq’ ma’nosidan keladi.
True dan truly, e tushadi; to‘g‘risi noticeable, argument, happiness.

quiz.q: There is a serious ___ of nurses in the region. (SHORT)
quiz.why_uz: Shortage — tanqislik, yetishmovchilik; shortness esa qisqalik.

quiz.q: Neither side would compromise; their ___ was obvious. (WILLING)
quiz.why_uz: Possessive ‘their’ dan keyin ot kerak, kontekst esa inkorni talab qiladi: unwillingness.

quiz.q: Which suffix is no longer used to create new words?
quiz.why_uz: -th qotib qolgan qo‘shimcha (warmth, depth); qolganlari hali ham unumli.

quiz.q: A ___ judge has nothing to gain from the outcome.
quiz.why_uz: Disinterested an’anaviy ma’noda xolis; uninterested esa qiziqmaydigan degani.
